title: Determinant under row rotation
statement: For every natural number $p$, row $r_0$, and list of rows $R$, the determinant modulo $p$ of the matrix with rows $R$ followed by $r_0$ equals $(-1)^{|R|}$ times the determinant of the matrix with rows $r_0$ followed by $R$.
